drop.reason: Off-field: PD-1 inhibitor gastric cancer biomarker study (EBV/MSI); ctDNA is one of several correlates.
Near-duplicate: CCGA validation of the same targeted-methylation MCED classifier, same result as kept pmid:33506766.
Near-duplicate: same group's stage III extension of the stage II colon ctDNA MRD result (kept pmid:27384348).
Off-field: FGFR2-inhibitor resistance biology in cholangiocarcinoma; cfDNA is only one sampling modality.
Off-field: catalogue of osimertinib resistance mechanisms; ctDNA is only the sampling medium.
Breadth: postoperative ctDNA MRD predicts relapse (bladder), same kind of finding as the kept MRD papers.
Tool: analytical/clinical validation of a commercial cfDNA panel (FoundationOne Liquid CDx).
Breadth: personalized ctDNA MRD in breast cancer, same kind of finding as the kept MRD papers.
Near-duplicate: DELFI group's lung follow-up with the same fragmentome-based detection result (kept pmid:31142840).
Breadth: early ctDNA dynamics predict therapy response; kind already covered by pmid:33232761 and pmid:30125215.
Near-duplicate: same group's ctDNA methylation-marker approach applied to CRC (kept HCC paper pmid:29035356).
Breadth: ctDNA genotype predicting targeted-therapy response; kind already covered by three kept papers.
Breadth: another CRC MRD study (tumor-uninformed assay); colorectal MRD already covered four times.
Off-field: kinome-screen and cell-line study of CDK4/6-inhibitor resistance; ctDNA is minor supporting data.
Breadth: ctDNA molecular relapse detection in early breast cancer, same kind of finding as the kept MRD papers.
Off-field: phase 2 cetuximab rechallenge therapy trial; ctDNA is a correlative endpoint.
Off-field: RB1 resistance mechanism to CDK4/6 inhibitors; cfDNA only the sampling medium.
Breadth: ctDNA-tissue concordance (prostate); covered by kept pmid:29109393, pmid:30988079, pmid:31501609.
Off-field: drug paper on TAS-120 overcoming FGFR-inhibitor resistance.
Off-field: neoadjuvant nivolumab trial (NADIM) with a ctDNA biomarker sub-analysis.
Breadth: ctDNA as immunotherapy-benefit biomarker; kind covered by kept pmid:35121950 and pmid:29330207.
Breadth: ctDNA as immune-checkpoint-blockade biomarker; kind already covered.
Off-field: PIK3CA mutation spectrum from tissue genomic profiling, not a cfDNA finding.
Breadth: ctDNA genotyping clinical utility; kind covered by kept pmid:30988079 and pmid:29776953.
Near-duplicate: same group's follow-up on exosome DNA and ctDNA in pancreatic cancer (kept pmid:28104621).
Near-duplicate/benchmark: CCGA substudy comparing classifiers on the same samples (kept pmid:33506766).
Near-duplicate: same prostate group's cfDNA genomics and AR-therapy resistance result (kept pmid:29367197).
Breadth: ctDNA dynamics under immune checkpoint blockade; kind already covered.
Near-duplicate: same group's rectal-cancer version of the ctDNA MRD result (kept pmid:27384348).
Breadth: ctDNA as immune-checkpoint-inhibitor response biomarker; kind already covered.

notes: The kept set covers error-suppressed ctDNA sequencing methods (CAPP-seq, iDES, TEC-Seq, PhasED-seq, MRDetect), MRD and ctDNA-guided adjuvant therapy, methylation-, 5hmC- and fragmentomics-based (size, genome-wide fragmentation, end motifs) detection and MCED screening, clonal-hematopoiesis confounding, resistance and biomarker genotyping, and non-cancer or non-plasma cfDNA (transplant, microbial, CSF, exosomal DNA); ichorCNA (pmid:29109393) was kept although it introduces software, because its headline result is a finding (cfDNA-tumor exome concordance). It lacks cell-free RNA, nucleosome-footprint and tissue-of-origin deconvolution papers, and prenatal/NIPT work, none of which reached this shortlist, and it leans toward clinical oncology because the shortlist does.
